site_name: Feltham Hill Infant And Nursery School
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 020-PE-00-99-DR-A-9902 Rev P01, 020-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0001 Rev P01, 020-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0003 Rev P01, 020-PE-BB-ZZ-DR-A-1301 Rev P01, 020-PE-BB-ZZ-DR-A-1302 Rev P01, 020-PE-BH-00-DR-A-0010 Rev P01, 020-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-0804 Rev P01,020-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-0803 Rev P01 (received 26/04/2013) 020-PE-00-99-A-9903 Rev P02 (received 30/05/2013)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the 30th September 2014 the temporary building (labelled block H on 020-PE-00-99-A-9903 Rev P02) and surrounding hardstanding hereby approved shall be removed from the site and the ground returned to its former condition as a grass playing field.
description: Demolition of two classroom buildings, installation of a new single storey temporary classroom block, a single storey temporary classroom block, a single storey extension to the nursery block, installation of an additional door in the western elevation of the main building and installation of temporary hard surface.
